acceptanceCriteria: A source outside the allow-list is refused at acquire with a typed reason.
A member whose observed identity differs from the default cannot become FREE; it stays QUARANTINED with SOURCE_DRIFT and both pairs.
A failing or malformed identity command never frees the member.
`pool status` shows each member's observed identity and observation time.
Removing a pair from the allow-list does not strand a live allocation; the guard applies at release.
body: From GitHub issue beamfall/corvint#1029 (opened 2026-10-17). Feature request; not yet specified. Problem A pool member may serve different revisions of the application under test, and a holder may legitimately move one member to a non-default revision for a task. Nothing records which revision a member serves, which revisions are allowed, or that a released member is still on a non-default revision. The next holder silently gets a different environment. Current workaround A sweep script hard-codes the approved revision/tree pairs and a default, reads an identity report from the environment, and moves the member back before confirming it safe. Anyone who skips the script can free a drifted member. Proposal Pool config gains `allowedSources` (revision/tree pairs) and `defaultSource`. A member declares an `identity` command that reports the served pair as JSON. `pool acquire --source <pair>` accepts only allowed pairs and records the target. `confirm-safe` and release to FREE require t See beamfall/corvint#1029 for the full text.
title: pool: per-member source identity, an approved-source allow-list, and a drift guard before a member is freed (issue #1029)
